changeSet.author: druchek
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE sp_calc_quiz_stats AS BEGIN UPDATE q SET q.total_attempts = ISNULL(stats.attempt_count, 0), q.success_rate = ISNULL(stats.calc_rate, 0.00) FROM quiz q LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tq.quiz_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sa.id) AS attempt_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(aa.id) > 0 THEN CAST( SUM(CASE WHEN aa.is_answer_correct = 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(aa.id) * 100 AS DECIMAL(5,2)) ELSE 0.00 END AS calc_rate FROM task_quiz tq INNER JOIN student_attempt sa ON sa.task_id = tq.task_id LEFT JOIN question qn ON tq.quiz_id = qn.quiz_id LEFT JOIN answer_attempt aa ON sa.id = aa.student_attempt_id AND qn.id = aa.question_id GROUP BY tq.quiz_id ) stats ON q.id = stats.quiz_id; END;

rollback.sql: UPDATE quiz SET total_attempts = 0, success_rate = 0.00; DROP PROCEDURE sp_calc_quiz_stats;
